bio: Congratulations and welcome to Harvard! I was born and raised in the northern part of China, went to Beijing University for college, and have been at Harvard for almost twenty years -- first as a graduate student in Chemistry and now as the Assistant Director of Undergraduate Studies in Chemistry. I am also involved in teaching General Chemistry courses as a Senior Preceptor in Chemistry. I live in Penny1 with my husband, Louie, and our daughter, Ella. I love to spend my free time reading, watching TV shows, doing light exercises, and trying out DIY projects. I look forward to meeting all of you!
